title: Subway Violin
premise: A long drama of violin music in a subway concourse. Violinist Suwan and apprentice Shuanger guard the old violin Nightingale; Shuanger and Axi look nearly alike but wear different sleeve bands; the folding violin-case cart is crushed and must be avoided; repertoire notebook, count memory, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.

states.prime_performer: A woman violinist in her thirties, black beret, black performance coat, violin in left hand and bow in right, focused expression.
states.wrist_injured: The same Suwan: right wrist wrapped in a support bandage, bow tucked in her elbow, coat cuff frayed, still wearing the black beret.
states.silent_death: Suwan has closed her eyes forever, lying still on a abandoned-platform bench, performance coat over her chest, bow at her side.

states.young_apprentice: A fifteen-year-old apprentice girl, indigo scarf, silver stud in left ear, carrying a violin case nearly half her height.
states.adult_violinist: A woman violinist in her early twenties, still in indigo scarf and silver stud, upright build, old music bag on her shoulder.

states.intact: An amber old violin, a tiny nightingale carved on the scroll, bright strings, varnish with fine growth-ring grain.
states.cracked_top: The same Nightingale violin, a long crack in the top plate, varnish peeling beside the nightingale carving, tone hollow.
states.patched_repair: The Nightingale violin after patch repair: new wood set into the crack, nightingale carving still there, tone slightly muted.

states.intact: A hard-cover repertoire notebook holding a subway map, performance-permit copies, and set order.
states.damp_blurred: The same repertoire notebook soaked by underground damp: cover wrinkled, map corners curled, set lists bled.

states.intact: A black folding violin-case cart, nightingale sticker on the case face, handle intact, wheels free.
states.crushed: The folding violin-case cart crushed by a station repair tractor: case face burst, handle bent, nightingale sticker torn.

states.young_rival: A young woman violinist nearly identical in face to Shuanger, but with a silver-gray sleeve band and charcoal-black scarf, showy look.
states.remade_return: Remade Axi still wears the silver-gray sleeve band; a string-pressure mark on her brow ridge, charcoal scarf swapped for a short cape.

scenes.setting: Subway concourse at dusk (introduce five emergency lights · two signal bells)
actions: At dusk, violinist Suwan enters the subway concourse and takes the Nightingale violin from its velvet bag to tune.

actions.action: Five emergency lights glow under the concourse beam; Suwan looks up to confirm they will not glare on the violin face.
Two signal bells hang by the gates; before a train arrives they chime briefly, and Suwan stops the bow to let the sound pass.

actions: Suwan sets the Nightingale violin on her shoulder; the first melody echoes along the ad pillars.
Suwan unties the ribbon, opens the repertoire notebook, and writes the rush-hour set beside the subway map.

actions.action: She glances at the five emergency lights under the beam, then clips the permit copy back into the repertoire notebook.

actions: Suwan closes the repertoire notebook, sets the Nightingale violin back on its pad, and waits for the next train's noise to pass.

scenes.setting: Platform greets the apprentice (introduce rosin cakes)
actions: At the dawn platform edge, Suwan greets young Shuanger pushing the folding violin-case cart; screen doors mirror both shadows.

actions.action: Shuanger parks the folding violin-case cart outside the yellow line, locks a wheel, nightingale sticker facing the platform sign.
Suwan lays out three rosin cakes on the case lid and teaches Shuanger to tell new, old, and broken rosin apart.
Shuanger crouches to check the folding violin-case cart handle hinge, making sure it will not loose in a crowd.

actions: In the transfer corridor, Axi with a silver-gray sleeve band glances back from tile glare; her profile almost looks like Shuanger.
Axi wraps her charcoal-black scarf tight and bends to adjust her portable pickup.
Axi carries a light violin bag through the far transfer arrows, dodging the morning crowd.
Beside the yellow platform line, Shuanger and Axi brush past—one in indigo scarf, one with silver-gray sleeve band.
Shuanger steadies her silver stud; Axi presses her charcoal scarf; two similar faces turn toward the train lights together.
After the train leaves, they split at different stair mouths; their backs are cut in two by the platform sign.
Months later on a leak night, Suwan packs the violin spot alone in the subway concourse; the Nightingale violin leans by a pillar.

actions.action: Condensate from the ceiling drips into the repertoire notebook; map corners curl and set-list ink bleeds in the damp.

actions: Suwan clips the repertoire notebook behind an ad board to dry, then wipes mist from the Nightingale violin strings.
The performance season stretches on; every day Suwan finds gaps between announcements to play in the subway concourse.
In the morning rush she softens the tone as commuters stream past.
At high summer noon, AC drips in the concourse; Suwan wipes fine mist from the top plate.
Through autumn rain, pillar ads rotate three times; the Nightingale violin still hangs on her shoulder.
After the last New Year's Eve train, Suwan alone finishes one more piece facing the empty concourse.

scenes.setting: Platform patrol (yellow-plate luggage cart false friend)
actions: At dawn, Suwan patrols the platform edge; the folding violin-case cart sits outside the yellow line, wheel lock tight.

actions.action: She crouches to check the folding violin-case cart handle, hinge, and small wheels, ducking a gust from an arriving train.
Suwan returns to the concourse violin spot and confirms those three rosin cakes are still in the paper box.
Staff push a yellow-plate luggage cart across the platform, bed open, no nightingale sticker at all.

actions: Rush hour blacks out suddenly; crowds pack the platform edge; signs above the screen doors flicker.

actions.action: Suwan backs up guarding the Nightingale violin; a corner hits a metal bench and a thin crack opens in the top plate.
The folding violin-case cart is shoved toward the yellow line; the wheel lock pops and the case sticker scrapes the tiles.
The folding violin-case cart slides into the repair zone and is crushed by a station repair tractor; handle bent, nightingale sticker shattered.
Suwan holds the cracked Nightingale violin and retreats by a pillar, signaling Shuanger not to chase that cart.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (folding violin-case cart indirect · long-range emergency lights)

actions.action: The day after the blackout, Suwan writes the time the folding violin-case cart was crushed on a blank page of the repertoire notebook.
A remnant nightingale sticker from the folding violin-case cart is stuck by a concourse pillar; Suwan gathers the scraps into an envelope.
Suwan clips a photo of the folding violin-case cart's broken handle into the repertoire notebook to warn Shuanger away from the yellow line.
The five emergency lights under the beam still glow; Suwan reads the folding violin-case cart accident record by green light.
Tape covers the Nightingale violin crack; Suwan notes beside the notebook the last platform number of the folding violin-case cart.

scenes.setting: Patch-repair the violin (third state · replica violin false friend)
actions: Weeks later, Suwan brings a luthier to spread felt in a concourse rest corner, ready to patch the Nightingale violin.

actions.action: The luthier first sets out a replica violin for contrast—gloss similar, but no nightingale carving, plastic bridge.

actions: Suwan watches the luthier press new wood into the crack; strings hang loose to one side for now.

actions.action: After the patch, the Nightingale violin crack is steadied by new wood; Suwan gently tests a slightly muted tone.

scenes.setting: False friends: cleaning cart and station supervisor

actions.action: A cleaner pushes the cleaning cart to the platform edge; only mop and trash bags on it—no violin-case handle.
The station supervisor walks up beside Suwan, also in a dark coat, but the walkie-talkie on his chest keeps flashing.
The station supervisor points at the cleaning cart and warns her to yield; Suwan holds the patched Nightingale violin steadier.

scenes.setting: False friend: Xiaoyu who resembles Shuanger

actions.action: From the transfer corridor comes flower-seller Xiaoyu; under a light-brown scarf her profile at a glance looks like young Shuanger.
When Xiaoyu offers flowers her wireless in-ear shows; Suwan only asks her to avoid the crowd by the violin spot.

scenes.setting: Wrist injured, bow stopped (long-range signal-bell recall)

actions.action: At dusk years later, Suwan with a bandaged right wrist alone enters the sealed abandoned platform.
Two old signal bells still hang by the abandoned-platform gates; Suwan stops to hear them clink in the draft.

actions: Suwan presses her bowless right hand to the cold bench, as if saying goodbye to this concourse.

actions.action: By day, adult Shuanger returns along the transfer corridor; the indigo scarf sways lightly in the empty-platform wind.

actions: By the abandoned-platform bench Shuanger steadies wrist-injured Suwan and takes her old music bag.

actions.action: Beside the bench, Shuanger holds Suwan's cold hand and hears where the performance permit plaque hangs.
Suwan's breath fades; at last she closes her eyes and dies in silence.
Suwan's black beret still hangs in the abandoned-platform locker; Shuanger brushes the dust away.
Adult Shuanger rehangs the performance permit plaque on a concourse pillar; Suwan's permit number is still engraved.
Shuanger traces Suwan's name on the performance permit plaque, then sets the patched Nightingale violin at the center of the violin spot.
Remade Axi walks in from outside the abandoned platform; silver-gray sleeve band still on her left arm, facing Shuanger across the yellow line.

actions: Shuanger and Axi stand side by side before the bench—one calm in indigo scarf, one with a short cape over a dark violin bag.

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—the girl in indigo scarf learning to apply rosin by the case appears again.

anchor.phrase: the girl learning to apply rosin by the case

actions.action: The opening moment returns—the amber violin with a nightingale carved on the scroll first rests against the shoulder.

anchor.phrase: the amber violin first set to the shoulder at the opening

actions.action: Flash back to an early transfer corridor—a figure with silver-gray sleeve band and charcoal scarf flashes through tile glare.

anchor.phrase: the figure with silver-gray sleeve band in the early transfer corridor

actions.action: Again five green lights under the beam light an empty-concourse old night.

anchor.phrase: five green lights under the beam lighting an empty-concourse old night

actions.action: Back to the yellow line of first meeting; tunnel wind stirs the signs, as if it just happened.

anchor.phrase: beside that yellow line of first meeting

actions.action: Shuanger opens the damp-blurred repertoire notebook and resets the rush-hour set in the subway concourse.
The five emergency lights under the beam still glow; Shuanger counts them, then dims the violin-spot lightbox.
Those three rosin cakes are still in the paper box on the case lid; Shuanger draws the first phrase on the patched Nightingale violin.
